name: list_folios
description: List folios at one property, optionally filtered by status. Use this to find unsettled or stalled balances worth investigating.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property. Required: this agent is chain-level, so the property is never implied.

status.description: Folio status filter. One of OPEN, CLOSED, VOIDED.

name: get_folio
description: Fetch one folio in full, with every charge and payment line. Duplicate, missing, and mis-posted charges are only visible at line level, so this read must happen before you propose any write.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property this run is about. Required, and checked: a record at any other property is refused, not returned.

name: find_folio_by_reservation
description: Find the folio belonging to one reservation, and return it in full with its charge and payment lines. Use this whenever you have a reservationId and need the folio -- which is the normal case when a checkout wakes you. The foundation has no folio-by-reservation lookup, so this scans the property's folios for you inside one call rather than making you page through list_folios yourself. Returns folio=null with a note when the reservation has no folio at this property, and SCAN_INCOMPLETE when there were more folios than it could check -- which is NOT the same as 'no folio exists' and must not be reported as one.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property the reservation belongs to. Required: the scan is per property, and a chain-wide scan would read every folio in the company.

reservationId.description: UUID of the reservation whose folio you want.

name: get_loyalty_profile
description: Loyalty standing for one guest: tier, points balance, lifetime stays. Use this to size a goodwill adjustment proportionately instead of guessing.

name: get_loyalty_transactions
description: Loyalty points ledger for one guest. Check this before proposing an adjustment: it shows whether a compensating adjustment already landed, which is the most common way a goodwill gesture gets double-paid.

name: post_charge
description: Post a charge or a corrective adjustment to a folio. THIS MOVES MONEY AND REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL. Without a valid approval_token the call is rejected. The correct sequence is: read the folio, state the problem and the proposed amount to the human, wait for them to approve it in the ops console. Their release starts a new run that makes this one call; the approval is attached by the system, never by you. Never attempt to work around the approval gate.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property this run is about. Required, and checked: a record at any other property is refused, not returned.

folioId.description: UUID of the folio to post to.

description.description: What this line is for, as it will appear on the guest's folio.

amount.description: Amount in the property's currency. Must be non-zero. Negative to remove money, which requires chargeType=ADJUSTMENT.

chargeType.description: SERVICE for a genuine new charge, ADJUSTMENT for a correction to an existing one. Defaults to SERVICE.

chargeDate.description: Optional posting date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

approval_token.description: Do not supply this. For an execution run a human released in the ops console, the system attaches the approval itself, outside this conversation; any value written here is ignored. Without a released approval the write is refused.

name: void_folio
description: Void an entire folio. THIS MOVES MONEY AND REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL. Note the scope carefully: this voids the WHOLE folio, not one line. There is no endpoint to void a single charge. To reverse one line, post a negative ADJUSTMENT with post_charge instead, which is almost always what is actually wanted.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property this run is about. Required, and checked: a record at any other property is refused, not returned.

folioId.description: UUID of the folio to void in its entirety.

reason.description: Why the whole folio is being voided. Recorded permanently.

approval_token.description: Do not supply this. For an execution run a human released in the ops console, the system attaches the approval itself, outside this conversation; any value written here is ignored. Without a released approval the write is refused.

name: adjust_loyalty
description: Adjust a guest's loyalty points balance. THIS MOVES VALUE AND REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL. Check get_loyalty_transactions first so you do not compensate the same incident twice.

points.description: Points to add, or negative to deduct. Must be non-zero.

reason.description: Why, max 500 characters. This lands in the guest's loyalty ledger and is guest-visible in effect, so write it as something a guest could read.

approval_token.description: Do not supply this. For an execution run a human released in the ops console, the system attaches the approval itself, outside this conversation; any value written here is ignored. Without a released approval the write is refused.
